BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the protection of residents of longterm carefacilities; and adding a new section to chapter 70.129 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.129 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A longterm care facility or nursing facility licensed underchapter 18.51 RCW must fully disclose to residents the facility's policy on accepting medicaid as a payment source. The policy shallclearly state the circumstances under which the facility provides carefor medicaid eligible residents and for residents who may later becomeeligible for medicaid. The facility policy provided to the resident isconsidered a legally binding contract between the resident and thefacility. The policy cannot be unilaterally changed by the facilityand cannot state that it may vary depending upon future circumstances.Policies used by nursing facilities must be consistent with RCW74.42.055. (2) The policy under this section must be provided to residentsorally and in writing prior to admission, in a language that theresident or the resident's representative understands. The written p. 1 SB 6009policy must be in type font no smaller than fourteen point and writtenon a page that is separate from other documents. The policy must besigned and dated by the resident or the resident's representative, ifthe resident lacks capacity. The facility must retain a copy of thedisclosure. Current residents must receive a copy of the policyconsistent with this section by the effective date of this act. (3) If a longterm care facility participates in the state medicaidprogram for residential care and services under chapter 74.39A RCW,then a resident at the facility whose care is paid for with medicaidcannot be transferred or discharged from the facility on the basis ofthe resident using medicaid as a payment source.
